ops.title: Re-check macOS 26 SDK for custom File Provider domain-root placement API
ops.description: Through macOS 15 there is no API to place an FP domain root outside ~/Library/CloudStorage (forces the account-dir symlink indirection). Re-check the macOS 26 SDK (NSFileProviderDomain testingModes / domain root options) at Track C/D implementation time; if an API exists, the symlink consolidation (pool.ClassifyAccountDir) is the single seam to swap.

ops.text: macOS 26 SDK audited; verdict + citation recorded here
